turns.q: How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?

take 7-12 business days total from order placement to arrival, and once your order is built, a tracking number is usually sent within 1-2 business days

.

turns.replyTail:

What should I do if the tracking never updates?

If tracking shows "pending," that usually just means the package is held up in the shipping process. Carriers can take 1-5 business days after production to scan the package, so a little lag at the start is normal 
.

If it's been longer than that with no updates, reach out to us here in chat and we'll help investigate. Have you received a tracking number yet, or is it still not showing in your emails?

How do I find my tracking link?

Your tracking link comes in the Shipping Confirmation email we send from no-reply@selectblinds.com as soon as your order ships. Check your spam folder if you don't see it, since all our order emails come from that address 
.

If you'd rather not dig for the email, I can pull up your order right here and get you the tracking info directly. Just share your order number (starts with "US") and the ZIP code on the order.
